title: Myth vs fact: remote work myths

slides.headline: Remote work myths that quietly hurt your team
slides.sub: Three beliefs worth dropping this quarter.

slides.before: People who work from home are less productive.
slides.after: Output depends on clear goals and fewer meetings, not on where the desk is.

slides.before: You need to reply instantly to look committed.
slides.after: Fast replies reward noise. Agree on a response window and protect deep work.

slides.headline: The real problem is unclear ownership
slides.body: When nobody knows who decides, work stalls in every office. Remote just makes the stall visible.

slides.before: More video calls build more trust.
slides.after: Trust comes from doing what you said you would, and saying so in writing.

slides.quote: The best remote teams write more and meet less.

slides.headline: Which myth did your team believe?
